story.title: The Village Leader
paragraphs_en: Little Than Kyi daydreamed about opening big grocery stores. She imagined many aisles with many shelves filled with every food, drink, and sweet she had ever heard of. This was her dream, because after years of conflict, there was not much of anything in her Kayah village, including food.
Than Kyi never opened a grocery store, but she did find other ways to support her village. She spent many years helping women and children, and resolving family arguments.

Then one day, it was time to elect a new leader of the village. To Than Kyi’s surprise, the entire village wanted her to be its leader. At first, Than Kyi said no—she had six children in school, and being the leader did not pay much. But the village insisted. They trusted her. Than Kyi felt it was her duty, so at age 45 she became her village’s leader.

Than Kyi does two big things in her job. First, she listens to her villagers’ problems, and she finds a way to fix them. Second, she represents her village in important meetings with the government. She tells the government her village needs better roads, markets, and public spaces for young people.

Than Kyi is the only female village leader in all of Kayah State. In fact, she is one of the very few Myanmar women serving as village and ward leaders. The good news is that more and more women are getting involved and are showing that they, too, can be great leaders. 'This is not a man’s job. A woman can do this job just as well,' Than Kyi often says. 'I am proof.'

Use these prompts to write your own story on a piece of paper. When are you happiest? What do you love doing? Life can be tough sometimes. Describe a tough moment in your life that you overcame. Tell a story of you future. What do you dream of doing?

sentences.text_en: Than Kyi never opened a grocery store, but she did find other ways to support her village.

sentences.text_en: Then one day, it was time to elect a new leader of the village.
sentences.text_vi: Rồi một ngày nọ, đã đến lúc bầu chọn một người lãnh đạo mới cho làng.

sentences.text_en: To Than Kyi’s surprise, the entire village wanted her to be its leader.
sentences.text_vi: Than Kyi rất ngạc nhiên, cả làng muốn cô ấy làm lãnh đạo của họ.

sentences.text_en: At first, Than Kyi said no—she had six children in school, and being the leader did not pay much.
sentences.text_vi: Lúc đầu, Than Kyi từ chối – cô ấy có sáu đứa con đang đi học, và làm lãnh đạo thì không được trả nhiều tiền.

sentences.text_en: But the village insisted.
sentences.text_vi: Nhưng cả làng vẫn kiên quyết.

sentences.text_en: They trusted her.
sentences.text_vi: Họ tin tưởng cô ấy.

sentences.text_en: Than Kyi felt it was her duty, so at age 45 she became her village’s leader.
sentences.text_vi: Than Kyi cảm thấy đó là nhiệm vụ của mình, nên ở tuổi 45, cô ấy đã trở thành lãnh đạo của làng mình.

sentences.text_en: Than Kyi does two big things in her job.
sentences.text_vi: Than Kyi làm hai việc lớn trong công việc của mình.

sentences.text_en: First, she listens to her villagers’ problems, and she finds a way to fix them.
sentences.text_vi: Thứ nhất, cô ấy lắng nghe các vấn đề của dân làng, và cô ấy tìm cách giải quyết chúng.

sentences.text_en: Second, she represents her village in important meetings with the government.
sentences.text_vi: Thứ hai, cô ấy đại diện cho làng của mình trong các cuộc họp quan trọng với chính phủ.

sentences.text_en: She tells the government her village needs better roads, markets, and public spaces for young people.
sentences.text_vi: Cô ấy nói với chính phủ rằng làng của cô ấy cần những con đường tốt hơn, chợ và không gian công cộng cho những người trẻ.

sentences.text_en: Than Kyi is the only female village leader in all of Kayah State.
sentences.text_vi: Than Kyi là nữ lãnh đạo làng duy nhất ở toàn bộ bang Kayah.

sentences.text_en: In fact, she is one of the very few Myanmar women serving as village and ward leaders.
sentences.text_vi: Thực tế, cô ấy là một trong số rất ít phụ nữ Myanmar đang làm lãnh đạo làng và phường.

sentences.text_en: The good news is that more and more women are getting involved and are showing that they, too, can be great leaders.
sentences.text_vi: Tin tốt là ngày càng nhiều phụ nữ tham gia và đang cho thấy rằng họ cũng có thể là những lãnh đạo tuyệt vời.

sentences.text_en: 'This is not a man’s job.
sentences.text_vi: 'Đây không phải là công việc của đàn ông.

sentences.text_en: A woman can do this job just as well,' Than Kyi often says.
sentences.text_vi: Một người phụ nữ cũng có thể làm công việc này tốt như vậy,' Than Kyi thường nói.

sentences.text_en: 'I am proof.'
sentences.text_vi: 'Tôi là bằng chứng.'

sentences.text_en: Use these prompts to write your own story on a piece of paper.
sentences.text_vi: Hãy dùng những gợi ý này để viết câu chuyện của riêng bạn lên một tờ giấy.

sentences.text_en: When are you happiest?
sentences.text_vi: Khi nào bạn cảm thấy hạnh phúc nhất?

sentences.text_en: What do you love doing?
sentences.text_vi: Bạn thích làm gì?

sentences.text_en: Life can be tough sometimes.
sentences.text_vi: Cuộc sống đôi khi có thể khó khăn.

sentences.text_en: Describe a tough moment in your life that you overcame.
sentences.text_vi: Hãy kể về một khoảnh khắc khó khăn trong cuộc đời bạn mà bạn đã vượt qua.

sentences.text_en: Tell a story of you future.
sentences.text_vi: Hãy kể một câu chuyện về tương lai của bạn.

sentences.text_en: What do you dream of doing?
sentences.text_vi: Bạn mơ ước làm gì?

sentences.text_en: Draw your portrait.
sentences.text_vi: Hãy vẽ chân dung của bạn.
